# LIFE On The PLANET LADAKH

> > Deep cultural narratives from Ladakh: monastery life, Changpas nomads, philosophy of silence, and daily practices in the High Himalaya.

LIFE On The PLANET LADAKH documents the lived experience of Ladakh through immersive storytelling by Elena Marlowe and Sidonie Morel. The site explores Buddhist monastic rhythms, Changpas pastoral traditions, water scarcity in Leh, and the philosophical dimensions of travel in regions like Changthang, Zanskar, and the Karakoram.

## Key Topics

- Ladakh culture and daily life
- Buddhist monastery life and Tibetan Buddhism
- Changpas nomads and pashmina pastoralism
- Changthang plateau and Rupshu
- Silence and Himalayan philosophy
- Leh and urban Ladakhi life
- Losar (Ladakhi New Year)
- Water crisis and jerrycan economy
- Pilgrimage as domestic practice
- Zanskar and Kharnak regions
- Polyandry and mobile pastoralism
- Geology, memory, and meaning
- Winter travel and altitude introspection
- Karakoram and Tibet borderlands
- Monastic schedules and time chronicles

## Philosophy & Meaning in Ladakh

- [Between Earth And Memory: The Conversations Of Ladakh](https://lifeontheplanetladakh.com/blog/ladakh-philosophy-travel): Ladakh philosophy travel: silence, geology & memory shape Himalayan meaning
- [大地と記憶のはざまで―ラダックの対話 (Between Earth and Memory: Conversations of Ladakh)](https://lifeontheplanetladakh.com/ja/blog/%e5%a4%a7%e5%9c%b0%e3%81%a8%e8%a8%98%e6%86%b6%e3%81%ae%e3%81%af%e3%81%96%e3%81%be%e3%81%a7-%e3%83%a9%e3%83%80%e3%83%83%e3%82%af%e3%81%ae%e5%af%be%e8%a9%b1): Ladakh travel philosophy: memory, movement & meaning in High Himalaya
- [Entre La Tierra Y La Memoria: Las Conversaciones De Ladakh](https://lifeontheplanetladakh.com/es/blog/viaje-filosofico-ladakh): Philosophical travel through Ladakh: silence, culture, geology shape meaning
- [ヒマラヤに耳を澄ます静寂の願い (Listening to the Himalaya: A Prayer for Silence)](https://lifeontheplanetladakh.com/ja/blog/%e3%83%92%e3%83%9e%e3%83%a9%e3%83%a4%e3%81%ab%e8%80%b3%e3%82%92%e6%be%84%e3%81%be%e3%81%99%e9%9d%99%e5%af%82%e3%81%ae%e9%a1%98%e3%81%84): Himalayan introspection in Ladakh: altitude, silence, humility reshape travel

## Changpas Nomadic Life

- [Les Fils Du Silence : La Vie Parmi Les Changpas](https://lifeontheplanetladakh.com/fr/blog/fils-du-silence-changpas): Changpas nomadic life in Changthang: pashmina, resilience, Himalayan silence

## Monastery Life & Buddhist Practice

- [Dal Primo Tè All'ultimo Chiavistello: Una Giornata In Un Monastero Del Ladakh](https://lifeontheplanetladakh.com/it/blog/orologio-del-giorno-ladakh-2): A day in a Ladakh monastery told through time, from first tea to last bolt

## Daily Practices & Pilgrimage

- [Le Pèlerinage Au Ladakh : Quand Marcher Devient Une Pratique Domestique](https://lifeontheplanetladakh.com/fr/blog/pelerinage-ladakh-marche-pratique-domestique): Pilgrimage in Ladakh as daily practice: walking village trails & chortens
- [Quando Camminare Diventa La Casa: Il Ladakh Come Sentiero Quotidiano](https://lifeontheplanetladakh.com/it/blog/camminare-casa-ladakh-sentiero-quotidiano): Daily walking in Ladakh: water fetching, winter paths, monastery circuits

## Urban Life & Contemporary Issues

- [Ladakh Water Crisis: A Kitchen In Leh And The Jerrycan Economy](https://lifeontheplanetladakh.com/blog/ladakh-water-crisis-kitchen): Leh kitchen view of Ladakh water crisis: jerrycans, queues, supply windows
- [Losar In Leh: Three Winter Days Of Ladakhi New Year Scenes](https://lifeontheplanetladakh.com/de/blog/losar-in-leh): Losar festival in Leh: three winter days of Ladakhi New Year preparations

## Natural Phenomena & Silence

- [Cuando El Silencio Brilla — Fenómenos Ocultos De La Quietud Viva De Ladakh](https://lifeontheplanetladakh.com/es/blog/cuando-el-silencio-brilla-ladakh-fenomenos-ocultos): Hidden phenomena in Ladakh's quietude: salt lakes, singing wind, light
